# casdoor_provider (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor provider: an identity provider for social sign-in, or an email, SMS, storage, payment or captcha service.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_provider" "github" {
  name          = "provider-acme-github"
  display_name  = "GitHub"
  category      = "OAuth"
  type          = "GitHub"
  client_id     = var.github_client_id
  client_secret = var.github_client_secret
}

resource "casdoor_provider" "smtp" {
  owner         = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name          = "provider-acme-smtp"
  category      = "Email"
  type          = "SMTP"
  host          = "smtp.example.com"
  port          = 465
  client_id     = "noreply@acme.example.com"
  client_secret = var.smtp_password
  title         = "Your verification code"
  content       = "Your code is %s, valid for 5 minutes."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) The category, e.g. `OAuth`, `Email`, `SMS`, `Storage`, `SAML`, `Payment`, `Captcha` or `Web3`.
- `name` (String) The name of the provider, unique within its owner.
- `type` (String) The type within the category, e.g. `GitHub`, `Google`, `Custom` (OAuth), `SMTP` (Email) or `AWS S3` (Storage).

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) The app ID, used by some providers.
- `bucket` (String) The bucket of a storage service.
- `client_id` (String) The client ID, app key or username, depending on the type.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret, app secret or password, depending on the type.
- `content` (String) The email body or the content of the provider.
- `custom_auth_url` (String) The authorization URL of a custom OAuth provider.
- `custom_logo` (String) The logo URL of a custom provider.
- `custom_token_url` (String) The token URL of a custom OAuth provider.
- `custom_user_info_url` (String) The user info URL of a custom OAuth provider.
- `disable_ssl` (Boolean) Whether SSL is disabled.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `domain` (String) The domain or base URL of the service.
- `email_regex` (String) Only emails matching this regular expression can sign in with the provider.
- `enable_pkce` (Boolean) Whether PKCE is used.
- `endpoint` (String) The endpoint of the service.
- `host` (String) The host, e.g. of an SMTP server.
- `intranet_endpoint` (String) The intranet endpoint of a storage service.
- `issuer_url` (String) The issuer URL.
- `metadata` (String) The SAML IdP metadata.
- `method` (String) The method, used by some providers, e.g. `Normal` or `Silent` for OAuth.
- `owner` (String) The owner of the object: `admin` for a global object shared by all organizations, or the name of an organization.
- `path_prefix` (String) The path prefix in the bucket.
- `port` (Number) The port, e.g. of an SMTP server.
- `provider_url` (String) The URL of the provider's console.
- `receiver` (String) The test receiver.
- `region_id` (String) The region ID.
- `scopes` (String) The OAuth scopes, separated by spaces.
- `sign_name` (String) The SMS signature name.
- `sub_type` (String) The sub-type, used by some providers.
- `template_code` (String) The SMS template code.
- `title` (String) The email subject.
- `user_mapping` (Map of String) How the user info fields of a custom OAuth provider map to Casdoor user fields, e.g. `id`, `username`, `displayName`, `email`, `avatarUrl`.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the provider was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the provider in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the owner (admin or an organization) and the name.
terraform import casdoor_provider.example admin/<name>
```
